item.title: Fans Choose Madonna and Peggy Gou’s ‘I Feel So Free (Peggy Gou Energy Mix)’ as This Week’s Favorite New Music
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to this week's music update. We've got the latest from Billboard, and it's all about the best new music. Let's dive in."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Madonna and Peggy Gou are taking the top spot with their remix 'I Feel So Free (Peggy Gou Energy Mix)'. This dancefloor-ready track is a preview of Madonna's upcoming album, Confessions II, set to release on July 3rd. It's her first full-length album in seven years and the sequel to her 2005 hit Confessions on a Dance Floor."
[Short music clip of "I Feel So Free"]
Host: "The original track was co-produced by Stuart Price, who's worked with Madonna on several projects. The Peggy Gou remix gives it a bouncy, high-energy twist, perfect for the club scene. And it's no surprise, given Gou's signature house sound and her recent breakthrough with '(It Goes Like) Nanana'."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Madonna teased the track at Coachella, where she performed with Sabrina Carpenter. But it wasn't the only big release this week. Drake dropped a massive triple album, Maluma released a new album focusing on family and roots, and Gracie Abrams debuted a new single from her upcoming album."
[Short music clips of various artists]
Host: "Other notable releases include Tove Lo, Rostam and Clairo, Jorja Smith, and collaborations like Shakira and Burna Boy, and Martin Garrix and Ed Sheeran. It's been a huge week for music, but in the end, Madonna and Peggy Gou's remix took the top spot in Billboard's poll."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in. We'll be back with more music updates soon. In the meantime, check out the full results of this week's poll and let us know what you're listening to."
